candidates.verbatim_passage: fire weather- Because local meteorological conditions are key drivers of wildfires, we derive a daily fire weather index known as the Keetch-Byram Drought Index (KBDI) as a principal input to the model. KBDI is a widely used tool to inform fire management decisions, such as fire suppression strategies. KBDI is calculated based on daily precipitation and maximum temperature data, with higher values indicating lower soil moisture, influencing the likelihood of ignition and spread of wildfire.
